@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Model: SessionModel holds the MCP servers of the session, each with its status'
+---
+## What
+
+AgentViewKit binds its views to the observable state of this client. It must show the MCP servers that a session was opened or resumed with. Now the client sends `NewSessionRequest.mcpServers` and `ResumeSessionRequest.mcpServers` (type `[MCPServer]?`, from FoundationModelsACP `Generated/Unions.generated.swift:692`) and keeps no copy.
+
+1. Add `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/MCPServerItem.swift`:
+   - `@MainActor @Observable public final class MCPServerItem: Identifiable`.
+   - `public let name: String` (from `MCPServerHTTP.name` or `MCPServerStdio.name`).
+   - `public let transport: MCPServerTransport`, a `public enum` with `.http(MCPServerHTTP)` and `.stdio(MCPServerStdio)`. A `MCPServer.unknown` value does not become an item.
+   - `public internal(set) var status: MCPServerStatus`. `MCPServerStatus` is a `public enum` with one case now: `.notReported`. Task "MCP server status" adds the cases of the agent.
+   - `id` is the name, because ACP names each server of a session.
+2. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`, add `public internal(set) var mcpServers: [MCPServerItem] = []` and an internal `func setMCPServers(_ servers: [MCPServer])` that makes one item for each server, in request order, each with status `.notReported`.
+3. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+Sessions.swift`:
+   - `newSession(_:)`: call `session.setMCPServers(request.mcpServers ?? [])` before `register(_:openedOver:)`.
+   - `replay(_:into:over:)` (used by `resumeSession(_:)`): set the list from `request.mcpServers` after the response. A resume of an open model replaces the list, and each item starts again at `.notReported`.
+   - A failed request does not change the list of an open model.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `SessionModel.mcpServers` holds one `MCPServerItem` for each HTTP or stdio server of the `session/new` request, in request order.
+- [ ] Each item has the name and the transport of its server, and the status `.notReported`.
+- [ ] `resumeSession(_:)` sets the list from the resume request, also for a session that is open.
+- [ ] A `session/resume` that fails leaves the list of an open model unchanged.
+- [ ] A request with `mcpServers == nil` gives an empty list.
+- [ ] `swift build` gives no new warning.
+
+## Tests
+
+- Add tests to `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ConnectionModelSessionTests.swift` (use `SessionFactoryFixtures.connect()` and `InMemoryTransport` through `ScriptedStubAgent`, no sleeps):
+  - `newSessionHoldsItsMCPServersAsNotReported`
+  - `resumeReplacesTheMCPServersOfAnOpenSession`
+  - `aFailedResumeKeepsTheMCPServers`
+  - `aRequestWithNoMCPServersGivesAnEmptyList`
+- Command: `swift test --filter ConnectionModelSessionTests`, then `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+
+Use /tdd — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+## Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Write the four failing tests.
+- [ ] Add `MCPServerItem`, `MCPServerTransport` and `MCPServerStatus`.
+- [ ] Add `SessionModel.mcpServers` and `setMCPServers(_:)`.
+- [ ] Set the list in `newSession(_:)` and in the resume replay.
+#model #agentviewkit
\ No newline at end of file
